mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MB_REFRESH_TOKEN ( TOKEN_NO, TOKEN_HASH, USER_NAME, PERSON_ID, CPNY_ID, DEVICE_ID, EXPIRE_DATE, REVOKED_YN, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_IP ) VALUES ( #{tokenNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{tokenHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{companyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expireDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'N', SYSDATE, #{clientIp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT TOKEN_NO, TOKEN_HASH, USER_NAME, PERSON_ID, CPNY_ID, DEVICE_ID, EXPIRE_DATE, REVOKED_YN, REPLACED_BY, CREATE_IP FROM MB_REFRESH_TOKEN WHERE TOKEN_HASH = #{tokenHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO MB_DEVICE D USING (SELECT #{deviceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS DEVICE_ID, #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS PERSON_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (D.DEVICE_ID = S.DEVICE_ID AND D.PERSON_ID = S.PERSON_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET D.CPNY_ID = #{companyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, D.PLATFORM = #{platform, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, D.APP_VERSION = #{appVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, D.OS_VERSION = #{osVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, D.DEVICE_MODEL = #{deviceModel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, D.ACTIVITY = 1, D.LAST_LOGIN_DATE = SYSDATE, D.LAST_LOGIN_IP = #{clientIp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, D.LANG = #{deviceLang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, D.UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( DEVICE_ID, PERSON_ID, CPNY_ID, PLATFORM, APP_VERSION, OS_VERSION, DEVICE_MODEL, ACTIVITY, LAST_LOGIN_DATE, LAST_LOGIN_IP, LANG, CREATE_DATE, UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( S.DEVICE_ID, S.PERSON_ID, #{companyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{platform, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{appVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{osVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceModel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, SYSDATE, #{clientIp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceLang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
